g.text: Enter the bash command to run:
This command will recursively and forcefully delete the directory '/tmp/testdir' and all its
Since '/tmp' is a system temporary directory, deleting specific folders inside it is generally
safe, but any data currently in 'testdir' will be permanently lost.
Once deleted, these files cannot be recovered easily. Ensure you no longer need them.
Are you sure you want to proceed?
